map.ROAS 和 ROI 有什么区别？: What Is the Difference Between ROAS and ROI?
map.ROAS=广告收入/广告花费，只看广告杠杆；ROI=(收入−总成本)/总成本，扣: ROAS = advertising revenue / advertising spend, looking only at the advertising lever; ROI = (revenue − total cost) / total cost, which deducts the goods cost and fixed costs and so reflects the real profit and loss more faithfully.

map.盈亏平衡 ROAS = 1 ÷ 毛利率。毛利率 40% 时只要 ROAS≥1.6: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ gross margin. At a 40% gross margin, ROAS≥1.67 breaks even and anything below loses money.
map.盈亏平衡 ROAS 怎么算？: How Do You Calculate the Break-Even ROAS?
map.输入广告投放费用与带来的收入，模拟计算ROAS、ROI与盈亏平衡点，评估广告投放: Enter the advertising spend and the revenue it brought to simulate ROAS, ROI and the break-even point, judge whether the campaign is profitable, and support marketing budget decisions and reviews.
map.：若利润为负，公式给出：转化率需提升到 预算/(客单价×点击量)，或客单价提升到: : if the profit is negative the formula gives the required conversion rate as budget/(average order value × clicks), or the required average order value as budget/(clicks × conversion rate). For example with 5000 clicks, an average order value of 300 and a budget of 10000 → the conversion rate must reach 10000/(300×5000)=0.67% just to break even.
map.：预算 10000 元、CPC 2 元、CTR 2% → 点击 5000、展示: : budget 10000 CNY, CPC 2 CNY, CTR 2% → 5000 clicks and 250,000 impressions; 100 conversions at an average order value of 300 CNY → revenue 30000 CNY; a 40% gross margin → goods cost 12000 CNY, total cost 22000 CNY and profit 8000 CNY. ROAS=3.0 and the overall ROI=8000/22000≈36.4%; the break-even ROAS=1/(1−0.4)=1.67, so the campaign is already profitable.
